key_insight: A closed-loop validation-repair workflow can lift clinical LLM outputs from inconsistent schema compliance to near-perfect interoperability-ready formatting.
clinical_relevance: This matters because healthcare AI must produce outputs that reliably fit standards like ICD-10, CPT, and HL7 FHIR before they can be safely integrated into electronic health record workflows.
method: Evaluated Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B locally
Compared baseline output with validation-repair using 960 model-scenario pairs
evidence_signal: Baseline compliance was 85.9% to 91.6%, while validation-repair increased overall compliance to 99.0% across models, with McNemar p-values below 0.001.
watch_item: The repair loop addresses formatting and schema issues, but it does not guarantee clinical correctness, so downstream validation remains necessary.
paper_title: Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs
